column1: # Ka 4-70 blade planform for the Kort nozzle - chord SYNTHETIC
# GENERATED BY cad/tools/make-geometry.py
# NOT a complete Ka-series blade. The Ka chord law is c(r) = K(r) * D * EAR / Z
# table is NOT IN SOURCE - the 2009 paper that carries the rest of the Ka data misnumbers its
# own cross-reference to it. So:
#   t_D and Xtmax_cr are READ from the real ka-thickness.csv in this folder.
#   c_D is SYNTHETIC - a wide-tip distribution scaled to hit the brief's Ae/Ao.
# Fetch Oosterveld (1970) to replace the chord column with the real K(r).
# From the brief: D = 250 mm
#   nozzle inner Ø 250
#   Achieved Ae/Ao = 0.7000.
# THE TIP IS SQUARE AND PINNED. r_tip_mm = r_R * 123.5000
# lands at exactly 123.5 mm - nozzle bore 125.0 minus the 1.5 mm gap. Chord is HELD
# near the tip (tip/peak 0.80); a Ka blade ends square close to the wall and must not be
# faired to a point. Rake is zero: the Ka series has no rake
# Xtmax_cr is the chordwise position of maximum thickness
